text:
maria: Ops reported several tenants seeing abrupt throttles while abuse-detector scores are low. Need clearer signal handoff between rate limiter and abuse heuristics.
kevin: Noted. Limiter only reads credits and a single hard-block from detector >0.9. No smoothing today.
jon: Proposal: tiny "prefilter" that normalizes detector outputs into short-lived tokens (bucket + soft_drop_prob) cached at the gateway. Rate limiter reads token from cache.
sara: Concern: extra hop on hot path. Can we make it cache-first with background refresh on miss? TTLs need careful tuning.
maria: Suggested TTLs: 5s for high-traffic routes, 30s for low-traffic. Prefilter returns bucket: ok/warn/block + soft_drop_p + ttl_s.
kevin: Failure modes: prefilter error -> fail-open (bucket=ok). Must have kill-switch flag and robust metrics: prefilter_hit/miss/error, applied_soft_drop, dropped_by_prefilter.
jon: API sketch:
POST /prefilter/eval
body: { tenant_id, fingerprint, route, recent_rate }
resp: { bucket: "ok"|"warn"|"block", soft_drop_p: "0.0-1.0", ttl_s: "int" }
sara: Tradeoffs: complexity, latency, and risk of bias. We'll normalize penalties by tenant baseline usage to protect small tenants. Add fairness tests in quota-sim.
maria: Rollout plan: staging canary -> shadow-mode prod 24h -> 1% traffic experiment -> 10% -> ramp. Run A/B for latency and false_reject.
ops-bot: scheduled calibration job pref-cal-20260320 to gather labeled samples every 6h for 72h. Will upload to s3://redwood-pref-cal/20260320.
kevin: I'll prototype cache layer and feature-flag; branch infra/prefilter-cache-proto.
jon: I'll stub gateway client and metrics. Shadow wiring first.
sara: I'll add normalization and fairness scenarios to quota-sim and write calibration checklist.
maria: Final decision: use categorical buckets for runtime contract, emit raw numeric score to telemetry for offline tuning. Action items assigned; follow-up sync Thurs 30m.
kevin: PR incoming. :thumbsup:
jon: will post shadow metrics once wired.
sara: adding integration tests now.
maria: Thanks team — aiming to reduce unexpected hard-throttles while preserving abuse protection.
